name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: A strip of links where one is the current page. Every clickable part is Clickable — Link for pages, Previous/Next as Clickable.Link with an icon. No button style in this file. The current page carries aria-current=page and is distinguished by a fill strategy (variant=outline), never by a colour. Previous/next chevrons invert under RTL via rtl:rotate-180. Ships no page-computation logic.
